---
title: "About"
---

jaxdft is developed by Mads-Peter Verner Christiansen, largely through agentic
development with Claude Code. Project conventions, physics invariants and the
milestone workflow are set out in `CLAUDE.md` at the repository root.

Every number in these documents is computed from the `jaxdft` package when the
site is rendered. The site is rendered as part of the project's definition of
done, so a document that no longer runs fails the build.
